title: Viva Glint: import HRIS data through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service
summary: Hold: the guidance incorrectly limits Global Administrator involvement to assigning a role, although Microsoft requires a Global Administrator for initial API-connector provisioning. The documented controls, licensing requirement and roadmap facts otherwise check out.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The get-started page states no price or meter for the import itself.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Using this import route requires administrator configuration rather than forcing an import on tenants.
claims.quote: The following steps describe how to create a data connection in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, configure access for Viva Glint, and import employee data.

claims.claim: The Glint switch is at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > Technical configuration > Organizational data imports.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then General Settings in the Service Configuration section. ... Technical Configuration ... Organizational data imports

claims.claim: No API for the Viva Glint Organizational data imports switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint "Organizational data imports" API setting. Read modis-data-import, modis-data-consumption, manage-general-settings and the service API upload reference; these document the switch in General Settings, not an operation to change it.

claims.claim: Completing onboarding automatically sets Organizational data imports to Yes.
claims.quote: After the onboarding process is completed, Viva Glint is configured to import employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. The Organizational data imports setting is automatically set to Yes.

claims.claim: Disabling imports stops ingestion and uploads return ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF.
claims.quote: When imports are disabled, Viva Glint stops importing employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, and uploads return the ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF advisory.

claims.claim: Viva Glint does not appear as a destination when Organizational data imports is disabled.
claims.quote: If Viva Glint doesn't appear as a option in the Choose apps and services page, it means that the Organizational Data imports feature is disabled in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: The Entra role assignment path is Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Roles & admins. ... Select a role name to open the role. ... Select Add assignments and then select the users, groups, or agent identities you want to assign to this role.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments assigns the selected directory role.
claims.quote: Use the Create unifiedRoleAssignment API to assign the role. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments

claims.claim: The portal assignment steps require at least Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Privileged Role Administrator.

claims.claim: The assignment request body identifies the role and recipient using roleDefinitionId and principalId.
claims.quote: "principalId": "<Object ID of user or group>", "roleDefinitionId": "<ID of role definition>", "directoryScopeId": "/"

claims.claim: The attribute-access route follows Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Data connections > + New import > CSV import > Choose apps & services > Viva Glint > Choose attribute access.
claims.quote: Select Data connections, you may need to choose + New import. ... The following example uses CSV import. ... Choose apps & services ... Select the Viva Glint. ... Choose attribute access

claims.claim: No API to configure the connection's attribute access is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service API "attribute access" "staging"; Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service "attribute access" API configure endpoint. Read import-org-data-api-call and import-org-data-api-changes; access is edited through portal steps, not an API.

claims.claim: Attribute access is configured separately for reserved and custom attributes.
claims.quote: Attribute access is configured separately for reserved attributes and custom attributes. For each attribute, select the applications and services that should receive the attribute data.

claims.claim: App-specific and custom attributes are selectable, whereas public global attributes are automatically available to Profile and downstream apps.
claims.quote: For supported destinations such as Insights and Viva Glint, you can choose which custom and application-specific attributes are distributed to each app. ... These public organizational attributes are automatically available to Microsoft 365 Profile and the apps built on top of it

claims.claim: The staging route follows Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Data connections > + New import > CSV import > Choose apps & services > Viva Glint > File upload, import method, and data staging > Data staging.
claims.quote: Select Data connections, you may need to choose + New import. ... CSV import. ... Choose apps & services ... Select the Viva Glint. ... File upload, import method, and data staging ... the Data Staging option.

claims.claim: No API for configuring data staging is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service API "attribute access" "staging"; Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service "data staging" API enable endpoint. Read import-org-data-api-call, import-org-data-api-set-up and review-quality-imported-data; staging is a portal setting.

claims.claim: With staging enabled, an Organizational Data Source Administrator must approve the upload before it flows to Viva Glint.
claims.quote: When the data staging option is turned on, the uploaded file doesn't flow to Viva Glint until an Organizational Data Source Administrator explicitly approves it.

claims.claim: Data staging is available for all connectors.
claims.quote: Data staging is available for all connectors, so administrators can review the actual data before it flows to downstream applications and services.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Organizational Data Service centrally imports and manages employee data for Microsoft 365 and Viva applications, including Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service provides a centralized way to import and manage employee data for Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Viva experiences, including Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Learn lists Workday, SuccessFactors, APIs, ADLS and file-based import methods.
claims.quote: Flexible employee data ingestion through multiple import methods, including Workday and SuccessFactors connectors, APIs, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and file-based imports.

claims.claim: The Glint import article uses CSV as its worked connector example.
claims.quote: Select a connector type. The following example uses CSV import.

claims.claim: The administrator selects destinations, maps attributes, configures access and begins validation.
claims.quote: Choose destination apps ... Map your attributes ... Configure data distribution ... Review and confirm ... Monitor import status

claims.claim: The service supports incremental and full imports.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service supports two import types: ... Incremental imports ... Full imports

claims.claim: For CSV, administrators choose the import type and incremental is the default.
claims.quote: Incremental imports are selected by default, but administrators can choose a full import instead. ... CSV: The administrator manually selects a full or incremental import.

claims.claim: Files up to 2 GB are supported.
claims.quote: Connectors support imports up to 2 GB.

claims.claim: The Glint import page gives ingestion time as a few minutes to three hours.
claims.quote: Overall ingestion can take from a few minutes to up to three hours.

claims.claim: The CSV service guide allows up to 24 hours for processing.
claims.quote: Validate and publish. Allow up to 24 hours to process (first upload can take up to 72 hours).

claims.claim: The CSV service guide allows up to 72 hours for the first upload.
claims.quote: Allow up to 24 hours to process (first upload can take up to 72 hours).

claims.claim: The CSV guide allows up to three days for complete profile-store availability.
claims.quote: Validation takes a few hours; however, it can take up to three days for your complete data upload to be available in the profile store.

claims.claim: The Glint side is enabled by default for new customers.
claims.quote: For new customers, Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is enabled by default.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Existing customers with employee data in Glint must complete one-time attribute-mapping onboarding before imports from the service.
claims.quote: Existing customers with employee data already configured in Viva Glint must complete a one-time onboarding process to map Organizational data attributes to Viva Glint attributes before Viva Glint can import employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The onboarding feature is released in phases and the banner may not yet appear in a tenant.
claims.quote: Organizational data in Microsoft 365 is being released in phases. If you don't see the onboarding banner, the feature isn't available yet in your tenant.

claims.claim: The get-started page labels the API-based connector Public Preview.
claims.quote: API-based Connector (Public Preview)

claims.claim: The other connectors in the get-started connector table have no preview label.
claims.quote: Searched: preview labels in Step 4: Choose your Connector Options at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/org-data-service/get-started. Read all five connector rows; only API-based Connector carries '(Public Preview)'.

claims.claim: The get-started page calls its Azure connector Azure Blob Storage, unlike the Glint page's ADLS wording.
claims.quote: Azure Blob Storage Connector | Microsoft pulls your .csv file from Azure Blob using a Blob container URL you provide.

claims.claim: Learn says only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.
claims.quote: Only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Public reserved attributes are shared with Profile and experiences consuming Profile data.
claims.quote: Public reserved attributes are shared with Profile and used by other Microsoft 365 experiences that consume Profile data

claims.claim: Those Profile-consuming experiences include Microsoft 365, Copilot, People card, Viva Amplify and Viva Engage.
claims.quote: including Microsoft 365, Copilot, People card, Viva Amplify, and Viva Engage.

claims.claim: Sharing of non-public reserved attributes follows access chosen by the Organizational data source admin.
claims.quote: Non-public reserved attributes can be shared with supported apps and Microsoft experiences based on the access chosen by the Organizational data source admin during connector setup.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Employee imports into Glint can include names, managers, hire dates and office locations.
claims.quote: The following public reserved attributes can be imported into Viva Glint: ... Microsoft_ManagerEmail ... Microsoft_FirstName ... Microsoft_LastName ... Microsoft_CompanyOfficeLocation ... Microsoft_HireDate

claims.claim: Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload, update and delete organizational data for specified applications.
claims.quote: Data upload and management: Permissions to upload, update, and delete organizational data for the specified applications

claims.claim: Organizational Data Source Administrators can connect supported HRIS systems.
claims.quote: This admin can also connect to human capital management (HCM) systems such as Workday and SAP SuccessFactors

claims.claim: The Workday connector pulls data using Workday credentials supplied by the organization.
claims.quote: Microsoft pulls data directly from Workday's Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) APIs using Workday credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: The SAP SuccessFactors connector pulls data using supplied SAP SuccessFactors credentials.
claims.quote: Microsoft pulls data directly from SAP SuccessFactors's public APIs using SAP SuccessFactors credentials that you provide.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft advises confirming approval for a direct Microsoft 365-to-Workday connection before choosing that connector.
claims.quote: Before you select the Workday Connector ... Confirm that: ... Your organization has approved a direct connection between Microsoft 365 and Workday.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft advises confirming approval for a direct Microsoft 365-to-SAP SuccessFactors connection before choosing that connector.
claims.quote: Before you select the SAP SuccessFactors Connector ... Confirm that: ... Your organization has approved a direct connection between Microsoft 365 and SAP SuccessFactors.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A full import replaces the imported employee population with the current import's contents.
claims.quote: Use full imports to replace the imported employee population with the contents of the current import.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Employees absent from a full import may become inactive in Viva Glint depending on configuration.
claims.quote: Employees that previously existed in Viva Glint but aren't included in a full import may become inactive, depending on your configuration and import behavior.

claims.claim: Workday refreshes are full imports, subject to the multiple-connector exception separately stated in the briefing.
claims.quote: Workday: Every refresh is a full import and sends a full-import signal to Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Schema changes to Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connectors automatically trigger a full import.
claims.quote: Any schema change for the Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connector automatically triggers a full import.

claims.claim: After schema changes on other connector types, administrators must resend all employees.
claims.quote: For all other connector types, after a schema update, administrators must manually send data for all employees through a new incremental or full import.

claims.claim: With multiple connectors, automatic full imports through Workday and SAP SuccessFactors are turned off.
claims.quote: If your organization has multiple instances of the same connector, or multiple different connectors, automatic full imports to Viva Glint through the Workday and SAP SuccessFactors connectors are turned off.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope: Limits
claims.claim: Each connector can send data to only one Viva Glint instance.
claims.quote: If your tenant has multiple Viva Glint instances, each connector can send data to only one Viva Glint instance.

claims.claim: Multiple connectors can feed Viva Glint.
claims.quote: You can set up multiple connectors to import data into Viva Glint.

claims.claim: A Glint manager hierarchy derived from an attribute mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail mirrors the Profile hierarchy.
claims.quote: If the Viva Glint manager hierarchy is derived from a Viva Glint attribute that's mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail, the Viva Glint manager hierarchy mirrors the Profile hierarchy.

claims.claim: The consumption page instead names Microsoft_ManagerID in its advice for distinct manager hierarchies.
claims.quote: If you want to keep the Viva Glint Manager Hierarchy distinct from the Profile or Entra Manager Hierarchy then don't map Microsoft_ManagerID to Viva Glint's attribute used for Manager hierarchy derivation.

claims.where: Scope: Who sets it up; summary; controls[1].governs
claims.claim: The Glint import documentation requires Organizational Data Source Administrator for creating and managing employee imports.
claims.quote: To create and manage employee data imports in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, you must be assigned the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.

claims.claim: A Global Administrator assigns the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.
claims.quote: The Organizational Data Source Administrator role is assigned by a Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Viva Glint service administrators may also be assigned the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.
claims.quote: Viva Glint service administrators can also be assigned this role when they need to configure employee data imports through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.where: Scope: Who sets it up; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A Viva Glint administrator completes schema mapping and enables Organizational Data Imports with HRIS-owner coordination.
claims.quote: Viva Glint Administrator | HRIS data owner | Complete Viva Glint schema mapping. Ensure imported attributes are mapped to the correct Viva Glint attributes. After configuration, enable Organizational Data Imports in General Settings > Technical Configuration.

claims.claim: Glint onboarding must be completed and Organizational data imports enabled before proceeding with the import.
claims.quote: Before proceeding, ensure that Viva Glint onboarding has been completed and that Organizational data imports are enabled in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: The five required Glint attributes are Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status and Employee ID.
claims.quote: Employee data imported from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service must satisfy the Viva Glint schema requirements, including the five required attributes: Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status, and Employee ID.

claims.where: Scope: Where to find it; controls[2].ui; controls[3].ui
claims.claim: The get-started page gives Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service as an admin-center entry route.
claims.quote: On the left, under Settings, select Viva. ... Under Data management, select Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The Glint documentation gives Setup > Migration and imports > Organizational data in Microsoft 365 as another entry route.
claims.quote: This toggle must be Yes for Viva Glint to appear as an optional end point for your connection in the Microsoft Admin Center at Setup > Migration and imports > Organizational data in Microsoft 365.

claims.where: Scope: Clouds and platforms; Open questions
claims.claim: The Glint documentation says the integration is available to all customers, including GCC Moderate customers.
claims.quote: The Viva Glint integration with Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is available to all customers, including customers with multiple Viva Glint instances, customers in GCC Moderate (GCC-M) environments

claims.claim: Custom attributes require an existing Glint attribute with an exact case-sensitive name match; otherwise they are not imported.
claims.quote: The custom Organizational data attribute name must exactly match the Viva Glint attribute name, including letter casing. If no matching Viva Glint attribute exists, the custom Organizational data attribute isn't imported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Viva Glint imports only attributes shared with it through that connection's access configuration.
claims.quote: Viva Glint imports only the Organizational data attributes that are shared with Viva Glint through the attribute access configuration for this connection.

claims.claim: Data connections exposes per-file validation and import status, ingestion summaries and advisories.
claims.quote: The Data connections page displays the files processed through the selected connection and the status of each validation and import operation. ... the validation page provides an ingestion summary and advisory details.

claims.claim: Learn does not state that the data-staging option is on by default.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service "data staging" default. Read modis-data-import, import-orgdata, review-quality-imported-data and API setup. They describe selecting Turn on data staging; the Staging default access policy returned by search is a different control.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: Global Administrator involvement can be limited to assigning the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.
claims.quote: The first time the connector is provisioned, a global admin must complete this step.
claims.fix: Remove ', and keep Global Administrator involvement to the assignment' from the first Before rollout bullet. Microsoft requires a Global Administrator for initial API-connector provisioning, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/org-data-service/import/import-org-data-api-set-up.

claims.claim: Attribute access is configured per connection, per application and per attribute, so Glint-specific choices do not change another application's selections.
claims.quote: Attribute access is configured separately for each application and service. ... For each attribute, select the applications and services that should receive the attribute data.

claims.claim: The cited pages do not state the organization's HRIS or Azure-storage costs.
claims.quote: Searched: cost, pricing and storage charges while reading the nine cited pages, including get-started, modis-data-import and import-org-data-api-call. They describe connector sources and consuming-app licenses, not HRIS subscription or Azure storage prices.
